# 查询账户配置 (USER\_DATA)

- **GET** `/capi/v3/account/accountConfig`

权重(IP): 5

**请求参数**

NONE

**请求示例**

```
curl "https://api-contract.weex.com/capi/v3/account/accountConfig" \
   -H "ACCESS-KEY:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-SIGN:*******" \
   -H "ACCESS-PASSPHRASE:*****" \
   -H "ACCESS-TIMESTAMP:1659076670000" \
   -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

**返回参数**

| 参数名 | 类型 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| canTrade | Boolean | 是否已开启交易 |
| canDeposit | Boolean | 是否允许充值 |
| canWithdraw | Boolean | 是否允许提现 |
| dualSidePosition | Boolean | 是否启用双向持仓模式。true 表示可同时持有多空仓位，false 表示单向模式 |
| updateTime | Long | 更新时间 Unix 毫秒时间戳 |

**返回示例**

```
{
  "canTrade": true,
  "canDeposit": true,
  "canWithdraw": true,
  "dualSidePosition": true,
  "updateTime": 1713339011237
}
```
